name: Luo Zuliang
current_role: Controlling shareholder of Dahu Health Industry Co. (600257.SS, formerly Dongting Shuizhi/Dahu Aquaculture) via Tibet Hongshan; chairman & GM of Tibet Hongshan and Dahu Industrial Investment Group
profile: Changde, Hunan entrepreneur (b. Oct 1957) who chaired and ran Hunan Dongting Shuizhi (later Dahu Aquaculture, now Dahu Health Industry), a Shanghai-listed freshwater fish farming and processing company, from 2000. His son Luo Dingkun now chairs the listed company; Luo Zuliang remains its ultimate controller via Tibet Hongshan (95% stake per 2025 filing).
interesting_fact: He was a deputy to China's 11th National People's Congress and to Hunan's 9th and 10th provincial people's congresses, and served as president of the Changde Entrepreneurs Association.
deep_cut_fact: Before aquaculture he was a state materials-supply manager: head of the Deshan supply station of the Changde Materials Bureau, then manager of Changde Materials Trading Center and GM of Hunan Dehai Industrial Group, before taking over Dongting Shuizhi in 2000.
notes: Little English-language coverage; the listed company is now run by his son Luo Dingkun (chairman). IR email is the board-secretary contact printed in Dahu's 2025 annual report summary (tel 0736-7266736 also listed there). Chinese-language outreach advisable.

name: Arvind Patel
current_role: Managing Director, Patel Infrastructure Ltd (Vadodara, Gujarat) — note one registry record shows his MD term ending Oct 2024; company is pursuing an IPO (DRHP filed)
profile: Arvindbhai Vithalbhai Patel runs Patel Infrastructure, the Vadodara road/highway EPC contractor founded in 1972 by his father Vithalbhai Patel as a builder of government buildings and hotels; his brother Pravinbhai Patel is chairman. The firm became a major NHAI contractor (Delhi–Vadodara, Ganga expressways) and has filed a draft prospectus for an IPO.
interesting_fact: In May 2025 Patel Infrastructure laid 34.24 lane-km (20,105 t) of bituminous concrete in 24 hours on UP's Ganga Expressway, a record recognised by Golden Book, India Book and Asia Book of Records; Patel called it a contribution to nation-building.
deep_cut_fact: Patel received Built India Magazine's 'Legendary award for outstanding work in road construction'; in an NBM&CW interview he argued technology 'will not replace employees, rather, it will alter the working pattern at construction sites.'
notes: Shares Hurun listing with brother Pravinbhai Patel. Company website (has Contact Us / Media Corner pages) blocks scripted access; check it manually for press/IR email, or the DRHP's compliance-officer contact. Confirm whether he is still MD given the Oct 2024 registry end date.

name: Rajesh Patil
current_role: Chairman (and promoter), Kolte-Patil Developers Ltd, Pune — now jointly controlled with Blackstone (40% stake, Aug 2025)
profile: Rajesh Anirudha Patil, a University of Mysore civil engineer, co-founded Pune developer Kolte-Patil in 1989/1991 with his brother Naresh and the Kolte family, growing it into a listed residential developer across Pune, Mumbai and Bengaluru. In 2025 Blackstone bought a 40% stake (~Rs 1,160 cr), giving joint control alongside the promoters; Patil remains chairman.
interesting_fact: In 2010 he shocked India's real-estate industry by hiring 28-year-old ISB graduate Sujay Kalele, making him CEO within a couple of years, bringing in IBM for an 11-year business-transformation project, and paying to be mentored by CEO coach Ram Charan.
deep_cut_fact: When he set up the company in 1989 after his engineering degree, he promised his parents he would never associate with politicians and would avoid debt; he says he made only two trips to Mantralaya in his whole career, and peers eventually 'decided to stop inviting me altogether' to industry meets.
notes: Shares Hurun listing with brother Naresh Patil (vice-chairman). info.kpdl@ is the general company email listed on the investor-services page. Blackstone now co-controls the company, which may affect comms routing.

name: Sharad Kumar Saraf
current_role: Founder, Chairman & Managing Director, Technocraft Industries (India) Ltd, Mumbai
profile: IIT Bombay graduate (B.Tech, 1969) who co-founded Technocraft Industries around 1971–72 with his younger brother Sudarshan on a small MIDC plot in Mumbai; it grew into a leading exporter of steel drum closures, scaffolding/steel hardware and cotton yarn/garments. He has also been president of FIEO (Federation of Indian Export Organisations) and of the Council of EU Chambers of Commerce in India.
interesting_fact: He has chaired the boards of governors of IIT Bombay and IIT Jammu as well as the Bombay Textile Research Association.
deep_cut_fact: A self-described student of history and cultures who has visited 50+ countries, he has backed the rejuvenation of Powai Lake (next to his alma mater IIT Bombay) and projects to improve cotton cultivation in Vidarbha; he also writes for Fair Observer and appeared on its podcast in 2023.
notes: Shares Hurun listing with brother Sudarshan Kumar Saraf. Active in export-policy circles (FIEO) and writes op-eds — a thought-leadership/export-manufacturing angle may land well. technocraft@ is the general corporate email on the company site.

name: Sudesh Kumari Dua
current_role: Whole-time Director and shareholder, Super Cassettes Industries Pvt Ltd (T-Series), per company-registry data
profile: Widow of T-Series founder Gulshan Kumar (married 1975) and mother of T-Series chairman/MD Bhushan Kumar. She holds a family stake in and sits on the board of privately held Super Cassettes Industries, India's largest music label and a major Hindi film producer; she keeps an almost entirely private profile.
interesting_fact: T-Series, the family's company, runs the most-viewed YouTube channel in the world and was the most-subscribed channel from April 2019 to June 2024 (first to 100M and 200M subscribers) before MrBeast overtook it.
notes: Very private; no personal public channels found. Best route is via T-Series corporate communications / son Bhushan Kumar's office. Avoid referencing her husband's 1997 death. Board role is from third-party registry (tofler.in/sudesh-dua/director/00128536) and may be dated.
